text:
Lord Jesus, I thank You with all my heart
for the great love You have shown me
in coming to me in Holy Communion.

You have given Yourself entirely to me.
Now let me give myself entirely to You.

May this Blessed Sacrament
strengthen me against temptation,
comfort me in my sorrows,
and inspire me to greater love
for You and my neighbor.

Stay with me, Lord, for it is necessary to have You
present so that I may not forget You.
Stay with me, Lord, for You are my life,
and without You, I am without fervor.
Stay with me, Lord, for You are my light,
and without You, I am in darkness.
Stay with me, Lord, to show me Your will.

I love You, Lord, and I desire to love You more each day.
Make my heart like unto Yours.

Amen.
source: Traditional Catholic Prayer (includes words attributed to St. Padre Pio)
